name: Accept the transaction
description: Applies regardless of which alert type/workflow this case belongs to.
check: Was the internet banking (IB) access already blocked for this case? (an IB_BLOCK action recorded with no later IB_UNBLOCK in this case's action history)

ifIbCurrentlyBlocked.note: The IB_UNBLOCK action below should itself carry the confirmation to send, via whichever channel(s) this case has already been using - do not invent a new channel

ifIbNotBlocked.description: Nothing to unblock - just close the case
